note: Real past games, races and pours with a publicly reported outcome. Every outcome below was read from the cited source URL on 2026-10-20; nothing is inferred. College baseball outcomes come from ESPN's public schedule API (final vs postponed) plus the team's own announcement for every not-played game. 'outcome' is played (the event went ahead, even after a delay) or not_played (cancelled, postponed, rained out or moved off the date). Start times, surfaces or coordinates that the source does not state are flagged in 'assumptions'. Events we could not verify are listed under 'excluded' with the reason.

excluded.event: College baseball games that were played (selection rule)
excluded.reason: from 2,110 ESPN home games (11 Texas programs, 2016-2025, not 2020-21) at venues with a known surface, the played games on wet days (ERA5 >= 0.25 in that day or >= 0.5 in the day before; 190 games) were sampled 2 per venue with random.seed(2026). Selected on weather only, never on what the model says.
